verdict.rationale: Gladia's pricing page lists async transcription rates per hour by model (0.27€/hr Solaria-1, 0.16€/hr Solaria-3 at 0–100 h/month, falling by volume tier). It also itemizes per-hour add-ons (summarization +0.03€, sentiment +0.02€, translation +0.05€, NER +0.07€, PII redaction +0.07€) and offers a cost calculator, so an agent can compute a job's cost before submitting it. The 'pay only for the audio you process' credit model supports this. Missing for 10: real-time/live per-hour rates not shown in the evidence, a machine-readable pricing source an agent could fetch, and independent corroboration that the published rates match billing.
